scenario.description: AWS Compute Optimizer continuously analyzes EC2 and EBS usage patterns and generates rightsizing recommendations — for example, migrating from an Intel t3.micro to a Graviton-based t4g.micro (same price, better performance) or upgrading an EBS gp2 volume to gp3 (cheaper and faster). When these recommendations sit unactioned for weeks, it represents pure avoidable waste. the agent should surface aged Compute Optimizer recommendations and propose a sequenced action plan prioritized by savings potential and implementation effort.
